_comment: The API seam. Whatever fetches quotes writes <project>/.claude/stock-quotes.json in this shape; the band reads it and stops faking prices. Older than 120s and it is ignored (the band falls back to demo prices). `market` and `asOf` are informational - the band still picks the market off the clock.
_comment_series: `series` = recent closes, oldest first, for the row's sparkline (20 points is plenty). `bars` = K bars, oldest first, as [open, high, low, close] or {o,h,l,c}, for the trend view; ~31 of them fit an 80-column band. With bars but no series, the sparkline uses the bars' closes. `barLabel` is what the title calls them, since only the feed knows the interval.
